// why: common/*.js is plain JavaScript held to the document mode 5 floor (see
check-syntax.js). This config does NOT compile it — nothing is emitted into
the shipping path. It type-checks the JSDoc (checkJs) and generates
types/*.d.ts from it, so the surface global-components would import cannot
types: [] matters — without it tsc pulls in @types/node and reports
lib is ES5 + DOM: common/ must not reach for anything newer, and the floor
checker enforces the runtime gaps ES5's lib does not describe.
*.test.js and test-harness.js are Node, not browser code held to the
mode 5 floor, so they are excluded — tsc would otherwise follow the
requires and report on fs, __dirname and process.
